bihar_raw_news.title: 50 lakh people affected in 15 Bihar districts as flood crisis deepens - MillenniumPost
bihar_raw_news.content: 50 lakh people affected in 15 Bihar districts as flood crisis deepens By - MPost Update: 2026-09-23 06:15 GMT Patna: More than 50 lakh people were affected as 576 gram panchayats in 15 districts of Bihar were inundated by floodwaters, with rivers flowing in spate showing no signs of receding. The authorities were running three community kitchens while 7,714 displaced people were sheltered in six relief camps, the Disaster Management Department said on Wednesday. According to it, around 50.49 lakh people have been affected by floods in 15 districts of Bihar, with rising water levels disrupting life in 576 gram panchayats. The affected districts were Patna, Bhojpur, Saran, Vaishali, Bhagalpur, Begusarai, Buxar, Samastipur, Munger, Katihar, Lakhisarai, Khagaria, Purnea, Madhepura and Arwal. The Kosi river was flowing above the danger mark at Baltara and Kursela, while the Ganga crossed its danger level at Kahalgaon. Three community kitchens are serving flood-affected people, having provided around 1.96 crore meals so far. Six relief camps are accommodating 7,714 displaced people, besides providing food and medical care," it said. Twenty-seven State Disaster Response Force and eight National Disaster Response Force teams are engaged in relief and rescue operations with 391 boats deployed. The state has received 661.9 mm of rain since June 1, contributing significantly to the flood situation. Despite this, Bihar has recorded 29 per cent below-normal rainfall, the weather office said. It has forecast light to moderate rain at many places and heavy rainfall at some locations from September 23 to 26.

bihar_raw_news.title: Bengaluru CEO says he won't hire men from UP, Bihar , Rajasthan, MP; faces backlash
bihar_raw_news.content: A social media post by Karthik SG , founder and CEO of ToBengaluru , has triggered widespread criticism after he announced that his company would not hire male candidates from Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh . The controversy erupted after Karthik shared a post on X stating that following what he described as a lengthy internal discussion, the company had decided not to recruit men from the four states. "We will not hire any male candidates in our company who come from these 4 states in north India," he wrote, before listing Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Bihar and Madhya Pradesh. The post quickly drew strong reactions online, with many users accusing the founder of promoting regional stereotyping and discriminatory hiring practices. Posts cited safety concerns and workplace culture In follow-up posts, Karthik attempted to explain the rationale behind the decision. He said the company works with young children and argued that safeguarding was a priority. He also claimed that men from the identified states came from a culture with "no respect towards women and children" and "no value of human life". Karthik further stated that the decision was linked to concerns around employee background verification, claiming police checks were not always reliable. His comments appeared to be linked to recent reports of crimes against women, including a Bengaluru case referenced by users responding to the discussion. Social media users challenge the decision The remarks prompted immediate backlash across X. Several users argued that hiring decisions should be based on individual qualifications, conduct and background checks rather than a candidate's state of origin. Among the most widely shared responses was a post from entrepreneur Aditya Arya , who criticised the approach and said screening should focus on competence and character rather than entire populations. Other users pointed out that crime occurs across India and questioned whether regional identity could reasonably be used as a proxy for workplace risk. Some commenters also argued that excluding candidates from specific states could amount to discriminatory hiring practices. A few users supported Karthik's position, saying organisations working with children should take extensive precautions during recruitment. However, criticism appeared to outweigh support across the discussion thread. Debate expands beyond one company The episode has reignited a broader debate around regional bias in recruitment and employment practices. Similar controversies have surfaced in recent years when companies or recruiters have been accused of excluding candidates based on language, geography or regional identity. Such incidents have often drawn criticism from industry professionals and social media users who argue that employment decisions should focus on skills and suitability for the role rather than birthplace or regional background. Neither the social media posts nor the screenshots circulating online indicate whether the hiring position has been formally implemented as company policy. For now, the controversy continues to play out online, with discussions focusing on workplace safety, hiring ethics, regional stereotypes and the limits of employer discretion in recruitment decisions.

bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary outlines major push for education, energy sectors - ANI News
bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary outlines major push for education, energy sectors ANI | Updated: Sep 23, 2026 08:29 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel Patna ( Bihar ) [India], September 23 (ANI): Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on Wednesday outlined his government's focus on the energy and education sectors in the State, detailing major advancements in digital education and electricity for the general public. Addressing the gathering at the ' Bihar Ke Sachche Nayak – Real Heroes of Bihar ' program, the Chief Minister revealed that 1.7 crore families have not received an electricity bill for an entire year, while only 22 lakh families currently pay for their power. "There are 1 crore 70 lakh families who have not received an electricity bill for a year. 1 crore 70 lakh. There are only 22 lakh families who receive electricity bills, friends. We said that this should also be connected to solar power because we need to move out of subsidies as well," he said. He emphasised that the State allocates approximately Rs 6,000 crore for agricultural feeders in rural areas, adding that Bihar will prosper when Bihar is become strong. "We provide agricultural feeders in villages. We give about 6,000 crore rupees for agricultural feeders. That is why there are many things that need to be organised. Bihar 's prosperity will only happen when we Bihar is become strong. And Bihar is stand on their own resources," he said. The Chief Minister further highlighted the development in the education sector, stating that the State government has established 700 model schools, with a capacity of 3.5 lakh students to provide top-notch online education through live classes, similar to Kota, Rajasthan. "We have established 700 model schools. 3.5 lakh children study in these 700 model schools. We started organising facilities for these 3.5 lakh children; along with online education, we started live classes," he said. "We saw that in Kota, lakhs of our children go to prepare for JEE and NEET. We said that we will provide preparation for JEE and NEET to 3.5 lakh children right on the land of Bihar . We did this in model schools," he added. In addition, Choudhary highlighted the impact of the 'Vidyarthi Sathi App', designed to support late-night studying, stating that over 1,42,000 students are actively learning online through the app as late as 1:00 AM. "I made an arrangement through the Vidyarthi Sathi App. Now, teachers are available to them on it. And you will be pleased to know that 1,42,000 children are studying online at 1:00 AM at night," he said. (ANI)

bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar : Long leave by chiefs of 3 police organisations raise eyebrows
bihar_raw_news.content: The Bihar bureaucracy is grappling with the reality of chiefs of three important police organisations proceeding on long leaves. Bihar DGP Vinay Kumar is on a 21-day leave, while Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) Chairperson Parmar Ravi Manubhai is away for 25 days and Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) Chairperson K S Dwivedi has proceeded on a month-long leave. Further, the Government has made alternative arrangements for two of the organisations. Preeta Verma takes additional charge as acting DGP, while Harjot Kaur Bamhra assumes additional responsibility as BPSC Chairman. But no interim arrangement has yet been announced for BPSSC. Absence of chiefs of three important police institutions in Bihar’s administrative and police framework has raised many eyebrows. national_raw_news.title: 19 mins ago | Regional News 41 Indian Railways commissions KAVACH 4.0 for first time on South Central Railway
national_raw_news.content: Indian Railways has achieved a significant milestone in railway safety with the successful commissioning of KAVACH Version 4.0 for the first time on South Central Railway. Railway Ministry said the upgradation from KAVACH Version 3.2 to Version 4.0 has been successfully completed over 108 Route Kilometres on the Malkajgiri-Kamareddi section of Hyderabad Division. KAVACH 4.0 brings enhanced safety, advanced technology, higher reliability and safer train operations. The Ministry said the latest version incorporates further technological improvements based on the experience gained from the deployment of KAVACH Version 3.2 in over one thousand 465 kilometres on South Central Railway. KAVACH is an indigenously developed Automatic Train Protection system designed to enhance operational safety. The system assists the Loco Pilot in maintaining trains within prescribed speed limits and can automatically apply brakes when required if the Loco Pilot fails to do so. KAVACH is designed to help prevent Signal Passing at Danger, control train speed in critical situations and reduce the risk of collisions. The system also supports safer train operations during inclement weather conditions. The successful commissioning of KAVACH 4.0 on South Central Railway represents an important step towards strengthening indigenous railway safety technology and expanding advanced Automatic Train Protection capabilities across the Indian Railways network.

national_raw_news.title: 24 mins ago | National 83 Ayushman Bharat completes eight years, over 60 crore beneficiaries covered under health scheme
national_raw_news.content: Ayushman Bharat – the Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana has completed eight years today. Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched this scheme in September 2018 from Ranchi, Jharkhand, which has become the world’s largest government-funded health assurance scheme. Prime Minister Modi said that the scheme has enabled record savings on medical expenses and benefited the poor and middle class. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that eight years ago, Ayushman Bharat was rolled out with the idea that every Indian should have access to top-quality and affordable healthcare. He said, today, more than 60 crore beneficiaries have access to five lakh annual health cover, making it the largest healthcare scheme in the world. The Prime Minister said, Ayushman Arogya Mandirs have already recorded over 500 crore visits, strengthening primary healthcare at the grassroots. Our correspondent reports that more than 48 crore 54 lakh Ayushman cards have been created so far. Over the past eight years, around 13 crore beneficiaries have availed cashless treatment, and the government has spent more than two lakh crore rupees on it. Under the scheme, a total of 38 thousand government and private hospitals have been empanelled. The scheme is now being implemented across all 36 States and Union Territories, marking a significant milestone in expanding healthcare access and strengthening the delivery of secondary and tertiary care services across the country. Recently, the Modi government has extended the benefits of this scheme to senior citizens of 70 years and 37 lakh families of ASHAs and anganwadi workers. The main aim of the scheme is to provide universal health care to the poor, needy and vulnerable sections of the country. Union Health and Family Welfare Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda today said that the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana scheme has transformed healthcare access for millions across the country. On the 8th anniversary of the scheme, Mr Nadda said that the scheme is turning the promise of quality healthcare and financial protection into a reality for families across the country. Nadda also said that the scheme is covering more than half a billion people across the country. In a social media post, he emphasised that the world’s largest Health Assurance Scheme has covered more than sixty crore people. The Minister further said that guided by the vision of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the Government remains steadfast in its commitment to strengthen an accessible, affordable and inclusive healthcare system. He added that the Government is also ensuring that every citizen can access quality healthcare with dignity and without financial hardship.

national_raw_news.title: President Murmu, PM Modi congratulate Indian skeet teams on winning Asian Games bronze 1 hour ago 43
national_raw_news.content: President Droupadi Murmu has congratulated Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Raiza Dhillon and Maheshwari Chauhan on winning the Bronze Medal in the Women’s Skeet Team event at the Asian Games. President Murmu also extended wishes to Anantjeet Singh Naruka, Bhavtegh Singh Gill and Mairaj Ahmad Khan on securing a Bronze Medal in the Men’s Skeet Team. In a social media post, the President said that their skill, determination and team spirit have made the nation proud. President Murmu also extended her best wishes to them for achieving even greater success in the future. Prime Minister Narendra Modi today congratulated Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Maheshwari Chauhan, and Raiza Dhillon on winning the Bronze Medal in the Women’s Skeet Team event at the Asian Games held in Japan. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that their focus, precision and teamwork have brought another proud moment for Indian sports. He further extended his best wishes to them for their upcoming endeavours. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also congratulated Mirabai Chanu on winning a Silver medal in the Women’s 49 kilogram Weightlifting event. In a social media post, the Prime Minister stated that her determination and consistency continue to inspire the nation. He further extended his best wishes for Mirabai Chanu’s future endeavours. Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr Mansukh Mandaviya congratulated Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Raiza Dhillon and Maheshwari Chauhan on securing the first-ever Bronze Medal in the Women’s Skeet Team event at the Asian Games. Mr Mandaviya extended wishes to Anantjeet Singh Naruka, Bhavtegh Singh Gill and Mairaj Ahmad Khan on securing the Bronze Medal in the Men’s Skeet Team. He also congratulated Mirabai Chanu on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s 49kg Weightlifting event at the Asian Games and described it as a proud moment for the nation. In a social media post, Mr Mandaviya said this is Ms Chanu’s first Asian Games medal and stated that this brings India another medal at the Games after 28 years. He also congratulated Jay Meena on securing the first-ever Bronze Medal in the Men’s Singles Soft Tennis event at the Asian Games.

national_raw_news.title: India’s medal tally reaches eight at Asian Games as women’s skeet team wins bronze 7 hours ago 136
national_raw_news.content: At the Asian Games, the Indian trio of Maheshwari Singh, Parinaaz Dhaliwal and Raiza Dhillon secured the bronze medal in the women’s team skeet shooting event at Aichi-Nagoya, taking country’s overall medal tally on Day 4 to eight. In another feat, Jay Meena made history in soft tennis, assuring country its first-ever medal in the sport. Jay has advanced to the semifinals, defeating Sherwin Nuguit of the Philippines 4-3 in a closely fought quarterfinal. In shooting, Double Olympic medallist Manu Bhaker has qualified for the final of women’s 10-metre air pistol event. She finished third in the qualification round. However, the trio of Manu, Suruchi Singh and Esha Singh failed to qualify in the team event. Indian swimmer Beniston Benedicton has qualified for the final of the men’s 100-metre butterfly event. He finished ninth overall in the heats to secure his place in the final which will be held at 1:38 PM today. In rowing at the Asian Games, Balraj Panwar has qualified for the final of the men’s singles sculls event. He finished third in his heat with a timing of 6 minutes 52.84 seconds and was fourth overall across the two heats. The final will be held tomorrow. India have also secured final berth in the men’s double sculls event. Satnam Singh and Salman Khan finished second in their heat, clocking 6 minutes 15.63 seconds. They finished fourth overall across the two heats and advanced to the final. In canoeing, the Indian Men’s Kayak Four team has qualified for the Final A. The Indian team finished third in the heats, clocking 1 minute 29.447 seconds to secure a place in the final. In Sepaktakraw, Indian Men’s Regu team defeated Philippines, 2-0 in the opening Group B match, registering 15-7, 15-10 win. Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu will take part in the women’s 49-kilogram final. The match is scheduled to begin at 10 AM. She will be aiming for her first Asian Games medal after finishing fourth at the Hangzhou Games in 2023. India is already assured of medals in Men’s badminton and Women’s Wushu. The Men’s badminton team will take on China in the semi-final today, after defeating Japan in the quarter-final yesterday. The match is scheduled to begin at 11:30 AM. In Wushu, Roshibina Devi will face Indonesia’s Thania Kusumaningtyas in the women’s 60-kilogram Sanda semi-final at 2:50 PM. India’s skeet shooters Anantjeet Singh Naruka, Bhavtegh Singh Gill and Mairaj Ahmad Khan will be in action on the final day of qualification. In Hockey, the Indian Women’s Team will face Thailand in their third Pool B match this morning. The match will begin 11:30 AM. Indian Men’s and Women’s kabaddi teams will also continue their group-stage campaigns. Yesterday, the Indian women’s cricket team clinched country’s first gold medal of the Games, defeating Sri Lanka by 147 runs in the final. The victory took India’s medal tally to seven. In Boxing, Jadumani Singh advanced to the pre-quarterfinals in the Men’s 55-kilogram category, while Sakshi Chaudhary also progressed to the pre-quarterfinals. Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr Mansukh Mandaviya has congratulated Parinaaz Dhaliwal, Raiza Dhillon and Maheshwari Chauhan on securing the first-ever Bronze Medal in the Women’s Skeet Team event at the Asian Games. Mr Mandaviya also extended wishes to Anantjeet Singh Naruka, Bhavtegh Singh Gill and Mairaj Ahmad Khan on securing the Bronze Medal in the Men’s Skeet Team.

national_raw_news.title: PM SVANidhi transforms street vending in Telangana, empowers 4.47 lakh vendors 11 mins ago 12
national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is completing 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. The PM SVANidhi scheme has transformed street vending in Telangana into a driver of formal economic growth and financial inclusion. Launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs and extended through March 2030, the initiative offers collateral-free credit in structured tranches of ₹10,000, ₹20,000, and ₹50,000. Implemented locally through Urban Local Bodies and the State Level Bankers’ Committee, Telangana consistently ranks among India’s top performers. The state has disbursed over ₹1,240 crore, reaching approximately 4.47 lakh vendors. Notably, women represent nearly 65% of local recipients, surpassing the national average. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has praised the scheme for lifting vendor household incomes by over 20% while integrating millions into the formal banking system. Ramesh, a Karimnagar vegetable vendor, expanded his micro-business to ₹1,00,000 in daily stock using progressive PM SVANidhi loans. With the introduction of UPI-linked RuPay SVANidhi credit cards for flexible, interest-free capital, the program continues to replace informal debt cycles with financial dignity and sustainable growth.
